page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmhfr6.20xlarge is a high-memory cloud instance configured for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a 3.1 GHz clock frequency across 80 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs. The system provides 768.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory density of 9.6 GB per virtual core. It runs under a KVM hypervisor environment and does not include dedicated GPU accelerators.

The instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps and includes no complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Storage is not bundled locally, requiring external network block storage for persistent data requirements. From a qualitative cost-efficiency standpoint, the dense RAM-to-vCPU ratio optimizes resource utilization for large in-memory footprints, eliminating costs associated with unused local drives.

Given its high memory capacity and dedicated compute allocation, the ecs.ebmhfr6.20xlarge server is suited for in-memory databases, enterprise caching, real-time analytics platforms, and SAP HANA deployments.
